evidence: Matched starts across all20 inits/four conditions; joint midpoint12/20 to final10/20 loses only init0 and8. Exact paired p0.5; single midpoint10/20 to final13/20. No causal interference established.
hypothesis: The two joint lost successes reflect different observable contact/lift/transport paths after additional optimization, rather than different starting inputs. This is a trajectory diagnostic, not an identification of the training cause.

options.name: existing_action_and_state_trace_review
options.reason: Cheapest falsifiable first step; detect divergence timing and whether failure phenotypes are shared before choosing an intervention.

options.name: headless_object_contact_replay
options.reason: Conditional next step only if stored robot/action evidence cannot distinguish stages. At most4 traces, fresh independent paths, exact initial/model/state/reward parity required; previous contact proxies not treated as necessary grasp conditions.

options.name: second_training_seed
options.reason: Would estimate seed variability but incurs substantial new GPU time and does not localize existing failure. Requires a separately registered bounded budget and matched exposure preflight.

options.name: longer_training_or_more_tasks
options.reason: No evidence of guaranteed monotonic benefit. Final progression gate failed; no blind extension or eight-task launch.

selected_cases.selection_scope: All and only the lost midpoint-to-final successes; selected diagnostic cases, not a new success-rate estimate.
